"""
Append airline reservation details to docs/travel_summary.docx.
Creates the file if it doesn't already exist.

Requirements:
    pip install python-docx
"""

import os
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH

DOCX_PATH = os.path.join("docs", "travel_summary.docx")

# ── Reservation details ─────────────────────────────────────────────
reservation = {
    "Reservation Code": "B75309",
    "Flight":           "FL398507",
    "Date":             "2026-09-16",
    "From":             "LAX",
    "To":               "LAS",
    "Class":            "Economy",
    "Amount Paid":      "$129 (Visa cc_9cdfc95d)",
}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def append_reservation(path: str, details: dict) -> None:
    """Open an existing .docx (or create a new one) and append a
    formatted reservation section."""

    if os.path.exists(path):
        doc = Document(path)
    else:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
        doc = Document()
        # Add a document title only when creating from scratch
        title = doc.add_heading("Travel Summary", level=0)
        title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

    # Section heading
    doc.add_heading("Airline Reservation", level=1)

    # Add each detail as a paragraph with a bold label
    for label, value in details.items():
        para = doc.add_paragraph()
        run_label = para.add_run(f"{label}: ")
        run_label.bold = True
        run_label.font.size = Pt(11)
        run_label.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)

        run_value = para.add_run(value)
        run_value.font.size = Pt(11)
        run_value.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x33, 0x33, 0x33)

    # Visual separator so future appends are clearly delineated
    doc.add_paragraph("—" * 40)

    doc.save(path)
    print(f"✅ Reservation {details['Reservation Code']} appended to {path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    append_reservation(DOCX_PATH, reservation)
